change: Prototype run-scoped channel for a trusted factual goal report. It is separate from returned tool data, rejects mismatched tenant/agent/run identities and unavailable/expired capabilities, clears reports on exceptional turn exit, and allows consumption only after a turn ends and only once.
coverage: Channel identity and lifecycle, 20 concurrent tenant/run contexts, stale inherited tasks, presentation and existing workflow-completion/size tests.
integration_status: Not installed in tool turns or normal chat. Caller must enable only an admitted standalone interactive final-report tool; mixed requests and native delivery need integration tests.
